claims.claim: DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light
claims.evidence: The witness saw a sticker on the top but the text was not legible.
The witness report describes the physical body but does not confirm the absence of wear or internal state.
Internal repairs or opening of the casing cannot be confirmed through photos alone without intact warranty seals.
The witness did not see the brightness of the light when turned on.
These documents were not shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Battery capacity is degraded or dead.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch remaining powered on for at least 10 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: as having a dead battery requiring replacement.

risks.risk: Charging port is loose or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the port and a video showing the charging indicator active when plugged in.

risks.risk: LED elements are partially burnt out or dim.
risks.proof: A video of the torch beam projected against a flat wall from a distance.

proof_requests: Legible close-up photo of the sticker/label to confirm brand and model.
Video of the torch being switched on and cycling through its modes.
Photo of the charging cable and the torch plugged into a power source showing a charging light.
Photo of the original receipt and warranty card.
response.reason: The item is identified as a rechargeable torch, which allows for a worst-case valuation. Confirmation of the brand and functional status would be required to justify a higher price.
